controlsRationale: Original800x600x16 mode114 single-player top-down shooter, WASD movement, mouse aim/fire and Esc end-match. Menu cursor0,0, Play rectangle20..220/160..210, Exit20..220/460..510. Camera follows the red bird, so world movement is observed through terrain/enemy displacement. Left WASD stick and right relative mouse stick preserve original unit motion. Shoot/Select uses original left mouse. Reserved panel keeps controls away from field and bottom health HUD in portrait/landscape. Relative touch only, no calibrated direct cursor profile. ExplicitGNU89 matches authored README Minix3.1.8/GNU toolchain and plain-inline emission. Declared relative path aliases preserve original image/debug paths, original code/assets stay otherwise unchanged.

artwork.icon: Simple authored bird-and-crossroads SVG motif rendered toPNG; original sprites/images unchanged.
artwork.preview: Actual normal-touch robot kill creates original explosion and damages the terrain, scaled to640x480.

verification.browser: Actual CDP touch in844x390 and390x844 selects Play, moves using original WASD, aims and fires. Original robot explosion and damaged terrain observed in both orientations, no page errors. Normal touch Esc ends the match, original menu returns, and Exit finishes with the source message Program finalized without errors and no page errors.
verification.ndk: All28 authored C units plus generated context compile as actual ARM64 objects with globalC11 before the selected GNU89 game flag, O2,FORTIFY2,stack protector and format-security.
verification.limits: Single-player qualified. UART multiplayer pairing and full survival duration unverified.

nativeGameplay.demonstrated: ROOT visual and source-art review: at least one robot-death explosion frame matches1792/1792 original pixels. Separate ordinary right pad hold shifts terrain left around the fixed player camera. Both sessions return Home and exit isolated game processes.
limitations: Representative solo native aiming, firing, one confirmed robot death and right-pad movement. Exact kill count, long survival, complete campaign, UART pairing and physical phone performance are not claimed.
